The existing `/private/tmp/nms-slice20-cc-capture.py` (58 lines) and `/private/tmp/nms-slice20-cc-attempts.json` (107 lines) were read completely before any product gate. The two recorded attempts are wrapper-only support controls, not CC product evidence: `support-known-7` exited 7 and `support-known-0` exited 0; both have nonempty, distinct stdout/stderr, start/end UTC, before/after status, working diff/untracked identity and the same baseline HEAD. Their author-run records are also preserved in planning `artifacts/cdc-review-receipts.json`; they are not counted as product gates. The capture implementation records a launch entry before subprocess execution and persists raw completion before post-metadata processing.

The contract consequence is that the new opt-in public `nms_save::address` API must decode the original borrowed JSON value strictly and independently of legacy typed conversion. In `nms-save/src/model.rs`, the current expanded structs use `serde(default)`, and `PackedGalacticAddress::visit_i64` casts negative input to `u64`; in `convert.rs`, discoveries and bases pass reality 0 and previous-location absence ignores planet/reality. Those legacy behaviors and bodies are frozen in this five-file foundation. Core `GalacticAddress::from_packed` masks to the existing 48-bit portal frame, so the decoder must validate the approved 56-bit field before constructing the core value with checked fields and the record galaxy; using `from_packed(raw, 0)` would erase the galaxy byte and improperly accept high bits.

The four public functions retain field-family choice and member presence at the API boundary: packed discovery/base values accept only JSON integers or ASCII hex strings with the prompt’s lexical/width rules; current expanded addresses require every member and validate integer kind/ranges before narrowing; previous absence is `None`, while only a fully present all-six-zero wrapper is the adopted sentinel. `None` differs from explicit JSON `null`. Typed `AddressDecodeError` variants must retain exact paths and range details with deterministic priority; ordinary malformed input returns `Result`, without panic or value dumps. Public examples use `?`, and fallible functions document `# Errors`.

The five-path limit keeps `Cargo.toml`, core address behavior, legacy model/conversion bodies, application/cache code and other worktrees unchanged. The independently specified Chili + 44-base projection and the literal synthetic high-precision, galaxy, signed-edge, width, path, expanded-presence/range, previous-sentinel and purity/error matrices are the observable test oracles; expected values must not be generated from the decoder or core round trips. The ordered validation is captured format, lint, focused external consumer test, remaining crate/core/no-default/workspace tests, build/docs/strict docs, then both captured diff checks. This is library capability only: required21 owns whole-source atomic application validation, caller migration and semantic cache transition. CC evidence remains proposed-done for CDC reproduction and acceptance.

No source edits, product compiler, test, or other SUT gate has run at intake completion. Implementation begins now under the existing assignment authority. CDC retains planning/index and independent acceptance; I own only the dedicated source/index/gates. No model or role substitution, added dependency, policy inquiry, native matrix, or work outside the five allowed source paths is authorized.
